title: Our Family Calendar
text:
Our family has a big calendar in the kitchen. It shows all the months of the year. My mother writes important dates in red pen. Today is the 5th of May, and it is my sister's school trip day.

My father's birthday is on June 20th. We always make a special dinner on that day. In August, we go to the lake for two weeks. The lake trip is my favourite date on the calendar.

questions.text: Why does the mother write dates in red pen?
options: Because she cannot write in black

questions.text: How does the narrator probably feel about the lake trip?

vocabulary.definition: a chart that shows the days, weeks and months of a year
the day each year when you were born
the one you like the most

paragraph_translations: Ailemizin mutfakta büyük bir takvimi var. Yılın bütün aylarını gösterir. Annem önemli tarihleri kırmızı kalemle yazar. Bugün 5 Mayıs, kız kardeşimin okul gezisi günü.
Babamın doğum günü 20 Haziran'da. Bu günde her zaman özel bir akşam yemeği yaparız. Ağustos ayında iki hafta göle gideriz. Göl gezisi takvimdeki en sevdiğim tarih.
